content:
zoe_cs: Quick flag on Polaris renewal5% expansion request. Customer wants a 6mo prorated add-on, split billing between Polaris US and Polaris EU, and PO for subscription. Theyre okay with CC for onboarding fee but EU procurement requires a witness clause on the SOW. Can we accept CC-first, PO-follow, and add e-witness language?

cal_sales: They're green on price if we support split invoices. PO ETA ~3 business days. CC to unblock onboarding is fine. Buyer asked that the PO be attached to invoice metadata.

mira_fin: Finance can accept a CC auth for the onboarding fee and finalize after PO. Need vendor codes and VAT/tax IDs for both entities. We will mark invoice metadata: `po: TBD`, `billing_split: US:70, EU:30`, `deposit_method: card_auth`. Also require procurement email in invoice notes.

leo_legal: E-witness OK in principle. I'll add a short Witness Addendum: "For the EU legal entity, an electronic witness (name + email recorded in signing audit) satisfies witnessing requirements." If buyer insists on wet witness we need logistics.

zoe_cs: Messaging buyer: "We can do CC auth for onboarding, include e-witness addendum, and accept PO within 5 business days to finalize invoicing. Please provide vendor codes, VAT, and procurement contact."

(docusign-bot): Template found: "Renewal-Split-PO-EWitness-Template". Can generate envelope with split invoice fields, procurement CC, and e-witness field. Reply with `create envelope` to proceed.

cal_sales: Buyer confirms e-witness acceptable and will send vendor codes + PO in ~72 hours. Charge CC after signing.

mira_fin: Approved. Finance will log provisional invoice and refund deposit if PO not received in 5 business days. Please capture procurement email on envelope.

leo_legal: Addendum text approved. One ask: include procurement email on the addendum page inside DocuSign so audit trail is explicit.

zoe_cs: OK proceeding with `create envelope`. Will post link and monitor signing + PO upload. Action items: - zoe_cs: send envelope + chase PO - cal_sales: nudge procurement ETA - mira_fin: finalize invoice after PO - leo_legal: upload addendum to contract repo.

(docusign-bot): Envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/0xabc-polaris-prorate-split. Routing: Polaris EU signer (e-witness) -> Polaris US signer -> Procurement CC -> Finance ack.
